command:
set -euo pipefail
set -a
. "$HOME/.config/omega/omega-mcp.env"
set +a
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, urllib.request
url='http://127.0.0.1:8789/mcp'; token=os.environ['OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN']
obj={'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':'gabriel-exec-e2e','method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'omega_execute','arguments':{'person':'gabriel','command':'printf OMEGA_MCP_EXEC_OK','cwd':'/tmp','timeout_seconds':30,'wait_seconds':0}}}
req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=json.dumps(obj,separators=(',',':')).encode(),method='POST',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept':'application/json, text/event-stream'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as r: reply=json.loads(r.read().decode())
p=reply['result']['structuredContent']
print(json.dumps({'state':p.get('state'),'command_id':p.get('command_id'),'machine_id':p.get('machine_id'),'owner':p.get('owner')},separators=(',',':')))
assert p.get('state')=='PENDING' and p.get('machine_id')=='ai-core-node' and p.get('owner')=='gabriel'
PY
